_doc: Data-driven config for programs/watchdog-systray.nix — a KDE system-tray applet (yad --notification) exposing the system-protection stack: live status, a manual OOM trigger, the escape-hatch keybind reminder, and a log viewer. Plus a companion NixOS tray. All labels/commands/units live here; the .nix only wires them.

oom._comment: Manual OOM trigger. kernel_sysrq=true uses the in-kernel SysRq OOM killer (echo f > /proc/sysrq-trigger) — the SAME action as the Alt+SysRq+F keybind, works even under heavy load (needs kernel.sysrq bit 64, set via sysctl). Falls back to killing the biggest non-essential RSS hog if sysrq is unavailable.
